open_points.subject: State 5 conventions — refusal persistence semantics
open_points.text: "A refusal writes nothing" ... "When a request makes several store changes, those made before the failed one stay"
open_points.question: When an MCP call ends with `internal_error`, must earlier successful store changes from the same call be visible, or must the whole call be rollback-atomic at surface level?
options: Expose earlier successful changes (per-store-call atomicity only)
Rollback all changes from the whole MCP call on any later `internal_error`
open_points.default_guess: Expose earlier successful changes, because transactions are defined per store call, not per whole MCP call.

open_points.subject: public_op:service_invoker.send_prepared_request output contract
open_points.text: "Outputs: One outcome name of the A09 rule 5 table for that class ... and a bounded `failure_detail`."
open_points.question: For outcomes that conclude `operation_failed` during send-time handling (for example `read` + 3xx), where does the required closed detail code (for example `redirect_not_followed`) come from: this operation's structured output or a caller-side reconstruction?
options: `send_prepared_request` returns a structured outcome-detail code alongside outcome
Caller (`effects`) infers detail code from transport/status data
No structured detail code is stored for send-time `operation_failed`
open_points.default_guess: Return a structured outcome-detail code from `send_prepared_request`.

open_points.subject: public_op:canonical_values.fit_port_value input/absence model
open_points.text: "Judge one value against one port — presence, carriage, schema, size, many" and "Inputs: One Port M01 and one candidate"
open_points.question: How is "presence" represented for this operation when it accepts a single candidate value argument?
options: Caller passes an explicit sentinel/flag meaning "absent"
Caller omits the field and `fit_port_value` is not called for missing fields
`fit_port_value` accepts a map of port->value so it can detect missing keys itself
open_points.default_guess: Caller performs key-presence checks and only calls `fit_port_value` for present candidates.
